name: Do I need to hire a separate painter after drywall replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a separate painter after drywall replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: While drywall replacement focuses on installing and finishing the drywall surface, many clients prefer to have the newly installed areas painted to match their existing decor or to achieve a fresh look. Maine Results, Inc. offers comprehensive solutions, which can include priming and painting the replaced drywall sections. Discussing your painting needs during the initial consultation ensures we can provide a seamless service from drywall installation to the final coat of paint, avoiding the need for additional contractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: You don't always need a separate painter. Maine Results, Inc. can include priming and painting the replaced drywall as part of our comprehensive service.
